newsitem.title: UK: Kazakhstan picks Bridas to operate pipeline system.
newsitem.headline: Kazakhstan picks Bridas to operate pipeline system.

text.p: The former Soviet republic of Kazakhstan has selected Argentine independent oil and gas company Bridas to operate its national gas pipeline system, the company said in a statement on Wednesday.

The Kazakh prime minister issued a decree in Almaty on Wednesday naming Bridas as the operator, and creating a ministerial-level working group to organise the concession with the company. The process is due to conclude on April 23.
The project will include building new pipelines to supply Almaty and the new capital, Akmola, and will improve the transportation of gas eastwards and westwards.

"We are pleased the government of Kazakhstan has selected Bridas to operate and develop its gas pipeline system which is of great domestic and geopolitical significance," said Bridas' chairman Dr Carlos Bulgheroni. "We look forward to improving the system over the next 15 years."
Kazakhstan, which sits on large oil and gas reserves, was advised by local and international banks led by Banque Paribas.
